records.title: Accreditation, Innovation, and Modernization: Secretary's Recognition of Accrediting Agencies: Institutional Eligibility under the Higher Education Act, as Amended, Student Assistance General Provisions
records.pass_4_primary_concern: The proposal relies on broad flexible accreditation criteria without fully specifying metric validation, implementation safeguards, and distributional effects.
records.pass_5_high_stakes_domain_reason: Accreditation recognition affects institutional eligibility for federal student aid and therefore student access and taxpayer exposure.

records.pass_5_concise_why: The proposal is broadly coherent but depends on flexible criteria whose validation, monitoring, and distributional safeguards are not fully specified.
records.pass_5_most_important_consequence: Outcome metrics or new accreditor competition could produce inconsistent recognition decisions before affected students and institutions have a practical way to detect and correct errors.
